description: Agent Skills: SKILL.md parsed and checked (name = folder, lowercase-hyphen, description required, body required, allowed-tools read as information); safe skill file paths; /name commands.
operation: parseSkill(input.text, { folder: input.folder }) -> { skill (base left out), problems }; skillFilePath(path); parseSlashCommand(text, names)

input.text:
---
name: proofreading
description: Proofread the document. Use when asked to check the text.
allowed-tools: find_text replace_text
license: MIT
---
# Proofreading
1. Read.
2. Fix.

skill.name: proofreading
skill.description: Proofread the document. Use when asked to check the text.

problems: the folder is "proof" but the name is "proofreading"; the format wants them equal.
name "Bad_Name" must be 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (not at the start or end).
description is missing: it is what the model reads to decide when to use the skill.
the instructions (the Markdown after the frontmatter) are empty.

output.error: "../secret.md" leaves the skill's folder or names a hidden file.
".hidden/x.md" leaves the skill's folder or names a hidden file.
"a/./b.md" leaves the skill's folder or names a hidden file.
"/abs.md" is not a path inside the skill: use a relative path such as references/guide.md.
"notes.exe" is not a text file the agent can read (md, markdown, txt, json, csv, tsv, yaml, yml, xml, html, js, mjs, ts, py, sh, sql).
